chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 474: Li Huowang Gambles His Eye for Bai Lingmiao’s Sight
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang gouges out his own eye as a promise to Bai Lingmiao. A quiet night of festival fun ends in a brutal dawn of self-sacrifice in this devastating chapter.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 474: The Brutal Cost of a Promise
og_description: A drunken Shangsi Festival night gives way to Li Huowang’s ultimate proof of devotion: ripping out his own eye to find a cure for Bai Lingmiao.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 474: The Eye He Gave
twitter_description: A moment of peace before a violent price. Li Huowang performs a bloody act of love in the heart of the Supervisory Heavenly Office.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient Chinese festival for purification and warding off evil spirits, traditionally held on the third day of the third lunar month. Often involves outings and cleansing rituals.
An ancient Chinese philosophical school advocating universal love and practical statecraft; in the Dao-Twisted World, a faction within the Supervisory Heavenly Office.
The heavily-guarded, underground treasury of the Supervisory Heavenly Office, containing supernatural artifacts and alchemical treasures.
A face-covering woven from old Chinese coins; provides concealment from supernatural perception.
A concealment artifact given to Li Huowang by Zhuge Yuan; hides its bearer from spiritual detection.
